rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible Day-5 expanded blastocyst assessment with reasonable ICM/TE grading, but includes several image-specific claims (vacuoles, debris, perivitelline fragmentation, precise BB-/BC nuance) that may be overcalled from a single image.
Integrates age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, smoking, prior ectopic, sperm parameters, and endometrium well, though some links to embryo competence versus implantation environment are somewhat generalized.
Overall logic is structured and internally consistent, and the probability estimate follows the stated factors, though some quantitative adjustments appear somewhat arbitrary.

Mostly consistent with standard IVF practice on morphology, smoking cessation, and ectopic surveillance, but recommendations such as routine estradiol addition, aspirin, ERA after limited failure, and PGT-A/ICSI suggestions are not strongly guideline-based for this case.
Gives clear practical next steps for transfer, monitoring, and lifestyle modification, plus future-cycle considerations, though a few recommendations are more speculative than standard.
